entries.title: Ilo, with Qloo and without: Claude Code
entries.summary: One frozen prediction and two arms, built at the same time by two subagents. With Qloo, the lamplighter became a grown person holding a rose-gold cup-lamp close; without it, a masked wanderer with an amber lantern on a pole.

entries.title: Ilo, with Qloo and without: Codex
entries.summary: The same game and brief in Codex, one arm after the other in one session: the baseline was built before any Qloo data was seen.

entries.title: Ilo with title-card portraits: Codex
entries.summary: The comparison again, with Codex's own image tool allowed: each arm painted a portrait for its title card from Moûsa's brief, and Moûsa checked each against the arm's palette.
